text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens, aged 18 or above (by June 15, 2022) and in good physical and mental conditions to perform successfully in an academic program in a foreign country. 2. Compliance with Chinese laws and university regulations; Record of academic excellence. 3. The applicant must be: A high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs. 4. English proficiency certificate. (Required for English taught programs). Applicants whose native language is not English, shall provide a IELTS score of 6.0 or a TOEFL score of 85 or higher.
